key_terms.مُدْهَامَّتَانِ: Darkest verdant green; a deep, rich green color

ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic term 'Mudhammatan' mean regarding the color of Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, particularly in Tafsir al-Qummi and al-Majlisi, 'Mudhammatan' is interpreted not merely as a color but as a symbol of the dense, enduring foliage of Paradise that signifies eternal vitality and divine bounty. This term appears in Surah Ar-Rahman (55:64) to describe the trees of Jannah, emphasizing the sensory richness of the afterlife as a reward for the faithful. The deep green hue represents a state of spiritual and physical flourishing that transcends the transient nature of worldly vegetation.
